translations.web: Now I know that Yahweh is greater than all gods because of the way that they treated people arrogantly.”
translations.bsb: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all other gods, for He did this when they treated Israel with arrogance.”
translations.kjv: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all gods: for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly
translations.asv: Now I know that Jehovah is greater than all gods; yea, in the thing wherein they dealt proudly against them.
